label: Character swap · MiniMax H3
blurb: Puts the character from Image 1 into Video 1 in place of one person. Their pose, timing, camera and scene stay; face, hair and outfit come from the photo.
source: akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA (native Ref2VA workflow, core nodes only) with the Ref2VA 4-step turbo LoRA
tips: Name the person by position or clothing; the rest of the scene is kept.
Short clips with one clear subject swap cleanest. Hard cuts and heavy occlusion can drift.
The clip is resampled to 24 fps and its length snaps down to the model's frame grid.

inputs.label: Source clip
inputs.hint: One continuous shot, 2–8 s. The person to replace should be clearly visible.

inputs.label: Character
inputs.hint: Who goes in. Full body shows the outfit too; plain backgrounds work best.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Replace only the woman walking toward the camera in <Video 1> with the character in <Picture 1>. Keep the replacement character's identity, face, hair, outfit and art style from <Picture 1>. Preserve the source video's camera, framing, background, lighting, objects and all other people. Match the selected person's position, scale, pose and movement throughout the clip. Do not show the reference image's background.
